nodes.description: Flag indicating whether minting has been permanently finished; written by finishMinting and reset back to false by enableMinting.
Flag controlling whether ordinary token transfers are allowed; set to true by enableTransfer and read by the canTransfer gate.
Owner address of the Ownable module; grants onlyOwner privileges over finishMinting, enableMinting, enableTransfer and recoverERC20.
ERC20Capped maximum supply (tokencap) that the total supply can never exceed.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn, bound by _cap.
Mapping of account balances updated by transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn paths.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances used by transferFrom.
AccessControl role storage mapping role=>RoleData used by onlyMinter and onlyOperator gates.
libcoin constructor: configures decimals, mints the initial supply to the owner and installs deployer roles.
Privileged minting entry point guarded by canMint and onlyMinter; can be re-opened by enableMinting.
ERC20 transfer override guarded by canTransfer(_msgSender()); gated while transfers are disabled.
ERC20 transferFrom override guarded by canTransfer(from); performs allowance and balance accounting.
Owner/Minter function that sets _mintingFinished = true, supposedly permanently shutting off minting.
Owner function that sets _mintingFinished = false, re-opening minting and defeating finishMinting.
Owner function that permanently enables public transfers by setting _transferEnabled = true.
ERC1363 overloaded transfer entry point that transfers tokens and then invokes a callback on the recipient contract.
ERC1363 overloaded transferFrom entry point that transfers tokens and then invokes a callback on the recipient contract.
ERC1363 overloaded approve entry point that sets an allowance and then invokes a callback on the spender contract.
Internal helper performing the external onTransferReceived callback and validating the returned magic value.
Internal helper performing the external onApprovalReceived callback and validating the returned magic value.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract to rescue tokens held by the token contract.
Hook chaining ERC20 and ERC20Capped hooks; enforces the cap when minting (from == address(0)).
Access-control modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Access-control modifier requiring the caller to hold MINTER_ROLE.
Access-control modifier requiring the caller to hold OPERATOR_ROLE.
Transfer gate checking _transferEnabled or OPERATOR_ROLE for the given account.
Minting gate checking that _mintingFinished is false.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, role and transfer-gate checks throughout the contract.
External callback IERC1363Receiver(to).onTransferReceived executed after the token balance update, enabling reentrancy.
External callback IERC1363Spender(spender).onApprovalReceived executed after the allowance update, enabling reentrancy.
External call to an arbitrary token contract in recoverERC20 whose boolean return value is ignored.
_mint(to,value) supply and balance arithmetic executed inside the privileged mint function under the cap bound.
_mint(owner(), initialSupply) executed in the constructor, initialising total supply and owner balance.
Owner-only state transition that resets _mintingFinished to false, re-enabling minting after it was finished.
Recipient address of the mint function.
Amount of tokens to mint, bounded by the cap.
Recipient address of the transfer function.
Amount transferred by the transfer function.
Source address of transferFrom, also used in the canTransfer(from) gate.
Recipient address of transferFrom.
Amount transferred by transferFrom.
Recipient contract address that receives the ERC1363 callback.
Token amount transferred by transferAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the recipient callback.
From address forwarded to onTransferReceived.
Target contract address that is externally called.
Value forwarded to the recipient callback.
Calldata forwarded to the recipient callback.
Arbitrary token contract address supplied by the owner to recoverERC20.
Amount of tokens to recover from the token contract.
Bytes4 magic value returned by the onTransferReceived callback.
Bytes4 magic value returned by the onApprovalReceived callback.
Source address of transferFromAndCall.
Recipient contract address of transferFromAndCall.
Token amount transferred by transferFromAndCall.
Spender contract address receiving the onApprovalReceived callback.
Allowance amount set by approveAndCall.
